lines.text: Chapter Two: Multi-page Layout

text:
This is the first paragraph on page one. It is written into a single text box and wraps across
several visual lines. Reconstruction must join those lines into one editable paragraph instead
of pinning each line with a hard break.

text:
This second paragraph follows a clear vertical gap. It must stay separate from the paragraph
above even though both use the same margins and the same body font size.

lines belong together and must never be merged
with the right column.

text:
A closing full-width paragraph follows the two-column band. It should join its own lines and
stay separate from both columns.

Section Two

text:
Page two carries a second section. Its paragraph is also a single text box, and the
reconstructed document should keep it after everything from page one.
